meta.title: Andrea Rodríguez — Industrial designer
meta.description: Portfolio of Andrea Rodríguez, an industrial designer and visualizer based in Colombia. Visual identity, branding, and digital illustration.

home.bio: Hi, I’m <about>Andrea Rodríguez</about>, an industrial designer and visualizer based in Colombia. My work focuses on visual identity, branding, and digital illustration, especially where an idea can become an image with a personality of its own. For commissions or collaborations, write to me at <email>andreacrodriguez99@gmail.com</email>.

nua.title: NÚA
nua.summary: To connect more closely with its audience, the brand aimed for a feminine, delicate, and fresh image with a calm energy. The identity runs through every touchpoint, from stationery to clothing.

seres.title: SERES
seres.summary: SERES is a wellness space in the mountains. The identity invites its audience into transformation, reflection, and quiet, through color, experience, and concept.

geoparque.title: Chicamocha Canyon Geopark
geoparque.summary: Developed for a UNESCO geopark application, the project captures the natural and community values of the Chicamocha Canyon in Santander, Colombia. It was a multidisciplinary effort in constant conversation with local culture.
geoparque.alt: Visual identity for the Chicamocha Canyon Geopark

geoparque-web.title: Geopark, website
geoparque-web.summary: An end-to-end design and development project. The interface gathers everything about the Chicamocha Canyon Geopark for anyone who wants to learn about the place and explore it.
geoparque-web.alt: Website interface for the Chicamocha Canyon Geopark

babilio.title: Babilio
babilio.summary: For a university app proposal, the team created Babilio, a character inspired by the caiman that lives on campus. The project includes the character and six illustrations of it in different activities.

calendario.title: Calendar
calendario.summary: A personal calendar of illustrations about calm, freshness, and friendship. Familiar characters inhabit everyday scenes from each season.

about.title: About
about.description: I am an industrial designer based in Colombia, focused on branding and digital illustration. I like to build projects with a style of their own, and to carry messages that feel personal. I believe an idea can become an image that connects with people.
about.toolsDescription: I also use AI tools through ideation, coordination, concept development, and exploration.

contact.title: Contact
contact.copy: Write to me. I’ll reply with availability and a clear way of working.
